title: S028 3.1.2 Control connection Receiver (may be PAC or PNS)
parent_path: S028 3.1.2 Control connection Receiver (may be PAC or PNS)

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If the version is earlier than the receiver's version and the earlier version can be supported by the receiver, the receiver SHOULD send a Start-Control-Connection-Reply.
statements.trigger: Start-Control-Connection-Request received with earlier but supported version
statements.pre_cond: receiver.state = idle & received.version < receiver.version & receiver.supports(received.version) = true

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If the version is earlier than the receiver's version and the version cannot be supported, the receiver SHOULD send a Start-Connection-Reply message, close the TCP connection and remain in the idle state.
statements.trigger: Start-Control-Connection-Request received with unsupported earlier version
statements.pre_cond: receiver.state = idle & received.version < receiver.version & receiver.supports(received.version) = false

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If the receiver's version is the same as earlier than the peer's, the receiver SHOULD send a Start-Control-Connection-Reply with the receiver's version and enter the established state.

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: In the event of a local termination, the originator MUST send a Stop-Control-Connection-Request and enter the wait_stop_reply state.

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If the originator receives a Stop-Control-Connection-Request it SHOULD send a Stop-Control-Connection-Reply and close the TCP connection, making sure that the final TCP information has been "pushed" properly.
actions: ensure final TCP data is pushed

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: If a Stop-Control-Connection-Reply is received, the TCP connection SHOULD be closed and the control connection becomes idle.
